title: UNDER 90 CHARS
takeaway: Silver’s industrial demand accounted for 53% of total demand in 2023.

data.label: Industrial Demand (2023)
data.evidence: According to a recent report by the Silver Institute, industrial demand accounted for approximately 53% of total silver demand in 2023.

narration: Silver’s unique industrial applications contribute to its stability and potential for appreciation. In 2023, industrial demand represented a significant portion of total silver demand, highlighting its versatility beyond just a monetary metal.
